## Overview

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| **Family / class** | Data and CPUE tools → length composition data |
| **Method name** | FishualizeR: R Shiny app accompanying FAO Fisheries and Aquaculture Technical Paper 706 (code: [DanOvando/fishualizeR](https://github.com/DanOvando/fishualizeR); app: [apps.upwellsolutionsllc.com/app/FishualizeR](http://apps.upwellsolutionsllc.com/app/FishualizeR)) |
| **Short description** | Interactive app that walks users through common visualisation and quality control of fisheries length data, and aggregates it into length compositions. |
| **Main outputs** | Plots of raw data (with colour and faceting options), data-coverage metrics over time or location, and length compositions in user-defined bins, all downloadable. |
| **Typical use case** | First look at length samples before a length-based assessment (FLicc, LBSPR, LBB): check units, gaps and coverage, then bin by year, area or gear. |

FishualizeR was developed (led by Brian Snouffer, Upwell Solutions) to support FAO Technical Paper 706, which sets out the data-preparation workflow: data inventory, timeline of influential events, life-history parameter inventory, cleaning and outlier handling, and exploratory data analysis. The app supports four steps: (1) upload length data and fix unit inconsistencies such as cm and mm; (2) plot and examine the raw data; (3) assess coverage over time or location and download coverage metrics; (4) aggregate into length bins at chosen levels and download the result.

## Use and misuse {#use-and-misuse}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
method_warnings("fishualizer")
```

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| **Pre-run checks** | [To be completed]{.todo} <br><small>Concrete checks an app or analyst runs before fitting, with the action if a check fails (after Gutierrez and Kleisner, 2018).</small> |
| **Do not use when** | Treating binned output as representative of the catch without checking sampling coverage and raising to catch. |
| **Common misuses** | Pooling gears or areas with different selectivity into one composition; ignoring years with very small samples. |
| **Pre-use checklist** | Units consistent; coverage by year and gear reviewed; sample size per gear-year noted (red flag below about 50 fish or 10 bins, see FLicc checks). |
| **Advice suitability** | Input data only: prepares length compositions for assessment; produces no stock status. |
